title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - TextileBasedSensor
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/TextileBasedSensor. A sensor directly integrated into a textile artifact (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.7). Subclass of saref:Sensor per the SAREF4WEAR ontology. The SAREF4WEAR ontology defines this class only as the range of an object property (it declares no own datatype property); the attributes below are reasonable, minimal descriptive fields added for a usable candidate model and are not themselves drawn from explicit ontology axioms.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TextileBasedSensor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

measurementType.description: Property. Open-vocabulary kind of measurement this textile-integrated sensor performs, e.g. 'ECG', 'strain', 'skinTemperature'.
